messages:
tori: dropping notes from UX review — new asks: 'explain mode' tooltip for each control, a delta-preview hover, and a small heatmap preview to recommend min. mock: https://figma.redwood/explain-capacity :mag:
ash: explain mode sounds useful. idea: a toggle that overlays one-line explainer copy on each control, with an optional 'why this matters' link that opens a tiny panel
devon: delta-preview hover = :100:. when you hover over Apply it shows a compact table: current vs new (Min / Max / Burst / Est. cost). keeps modal lighter
nina: heatmap: compute a simple request-distribution sparkline and show recommended min as a dashed line. backend can return recommended_min based on 95th percentile of concurrent requests
tori: accessibility: explain mode must be accessible via keyboard and expose aria-describedby on controls. if enabled, screen reader should read the short explainer when focus lands on a control
ash: microcopy tweak: prefer present-tense concise descriptions. e.g., 'Burst window (mins): duration for temporary extra GPUs, e.g., +2 GPUs for 20 mins.' keep examples localized-friendly
devon: small dev payload for heatmap/recommendation:
```
POST /api/v1/capacity/recommend
{ "pool_id": "pool-33", "history_minutes": 60 }
```
response: recommended_min, request_heatmap (array)

ux-bot: recommendation generated 1791234580 — recommended_min: "8", heatmap_url: "https://storage.redwood/heatmap/1791234580.png" :white_check_mark:

nina: keyboard: / focuses pool search; Shift+Arrow adjusts steppers by adaptive step size; hold Arrow for acceleration. Add visible focus ring and aria-valuetext combining value + unit
ash: delta-preview security: don't show raw currency if user locale prefers rounding — use 'small/moderate/large' or localized estimate. also add a 'show money' toggle in settings
nina: guardrails: when new settings exceed quota, show an inline amber banner with soft language: "This change may approach your quota. Applying will request capacity and could affect billing." include 'Request increase' CTA that pre-fills the form
ash: undo behavior: client keeps a reversible state until server confirms. show snackbar 'Changes applied — Undo' for 10s; clicking undo sends a revert activity and re-applies old settings
devon: activity log example for infra:
```
POST /api/v1/activity
{ "actor": "tori", "action": "apply_capacity", "details": "min:4->8,max:12->32,burst:0->30" }
```

tori: UI nit: add a small inline diff chip next to each control when preset applied (e.g., +4) and a global summary chip in header for quick glance
ash: A/B test idea: 'explain-mode-on-by-default' vs 'off' to measure support ticket lift. also test 'delta-preview-on-hover' vs 'open-modal' for conversion/time-to-apply
nina: accessibility extra: aria-live polite region for simulator updates but throttle to avoid noisy repeated announcements. avoid currency readouts if user opts out
infra-bot: noted. we'll add endpoints: /capacity/recommend and include quota_status, recommended_min, heatmap_url, and estimated_cost_bucket (small/medium/large)
ux-bot: exported updated comps 1791234685 (desktop + mobile collapsed heatmap) — https://figma.redwood/flow/1791234685 :white_check_mark:
tori: final action items: 1) design to add explain-mode copy + keyboard hints, 2) dev to implement recommend endpoint and delta-preview, 3) product to spec A/B tests and tracking events (explain_mode_toggle, delta_preview_hover, recommend_call). tagging infra & analytics. thanks team — closing after assets land :rocket:
